acceptance_oracle: Choose a saved search profile on Jobs; the UI calls /jobs with that profile ID and renders exactly the matching jobs. Changing the active career profile clears the prior profile selection and lists only the new profile's saved searches.
red_observation: Before the UI change, the connected browser test failed because the Jobs view had no Saved search profile control.
implementation: The Jobs view now offers profiles belonging only to the active career profile and sends the selected ID as search_profile_id to the existing profile-aware API.
Changing career profile immediately clears the saved-search list and selection. A stale prior-profile ID is not sent during the asynchronous profile refresh.
The existing database/API continue to own the profile criteria; no copy of filter criteria is stored in UI state or added to the schema.
